title: Application Security Testing Dashboard
description: A centralized security testing dashboard for managing applications, importing scanner findings, tracking vulnerabilities by severity and CWE, documenting evidence, monitoring remediation, and generating assessment reports.

title: Secrets Detection and Credential Exposure Scanner
description: A security scanning tool that detects potential exposed API keys, access tokens, private keys, and hardcoded credentials in source code repositories, configuration files, build artifacts, and Git history.

title: WebSentinel
description: A web application security scanner that maps attack surfaces by crawling same-origin links, sitemaps, script references, and JavaScript-rendered routes.

title: PostMessage Origin Scanner
description: A browser extension with a CLI companion that detects weak or missing window.postMessage origin validation, analyzes message listeners, captures runtime traffic, and generates proof-of-concept HTML for security triage.
